conviction_note: Q1 OP of 782m is already 55.9% of the unchanged H1 OP plan of 1,400m, so Q2 needs only 618m, flat on last year's 613m. A modest H1 operating beat is the likely print and leans positive. The lean is kept small for four reasons: that progress rate has been public since 7/17 and was bought then (+3.1%); the company's own Q1 text says part of Q1 construction demand was rental firms pulling procurement forward on Middle East supply worries; all three prior Q2 prints fell (-8.15, -1.12, -2.09); and margin longs are crowded at 12.1x. So p_up is 55 on abs 2.5, giving +0.25. Two documents point the same way, so the findings' sum of +0.7 sits above the scaled number.
bar: Company H1 (Mar 21 to Sep 20, 2026) plan, unchanged since 2026-05-01: sales 32,700m, OP 1,400m, ordinary 1,500m, net 960m (Q1 短信 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260717/140120260717595946.pdf). There is no IFIS consensus (zero analysts on https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=5933) and no 四季報 number was found, so the company plan is the only sourced bar. print_vs_bar_pct is my estimate for H1 OP (about 1,450m against 1,400m). H1 ordinary profit against 1,500m depends on Q2 FX lines whose sign I could not establish.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-10-19 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 12.12x, i.e. crowded margin long (baseline; kabutan shows the same 12.12 on 2026-10-20). No options and no skew. The 20d run-up of -4.45% includes about 2 points of the ¥22 interim dividend going ex around 2026-09-17. The company buyback was ongoing through September (74,400 shares in Sep).

findings.finding: Q1 OP of 782m (+21.6% YoY) is 55.9% of the unchanged H1 OP plan of 1,400m, against 48.7% at the same point last year (643m of a 1,320m plan, a year in which H1 then missed). Q2 (Jun 21 to Sep 20) therefore needs only 618m against last year's Q2 OP of 613m, so a modest H1 operating beat is likely. One caveat is netted in: the Q1 短信 attributes part of the +16.4% construction-equipment sales to rental companies rushing procurement on Middle East supply worries, which is a payback risk for Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Actual release dates computed from the Yahoo tape: Q1 FY27 'good progress' 2026-07-17 gave +3.11% next session. The H1 miss on 2025-10-20 (OP 1,256 against a plan of 1,320) gave -2.09%. H1 2024 on 2024-10-18 gave -1.12%. H1 2023 on 2023-10-20, below a revised plan, gave -8.15%. Median |move| over 12 actual prints is about 3.3%, against the baseline proxy of 1.7%, which used estimated dates.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the progress rate was public and the stock rose 3.1% on it in July, then gave the move back (1,061 on 7/17, 1,072 now, roughly 2 points of the drift being the interim dividend going ex). With zero analysts and no consensus, the only bar is the company plan. If the market were pricing a clean H1 beat, the stock would not sit at PER 9.7 on a plan the company missed by 29% last year. What it does not hold is confirmation that Q2 did not give back the Q1 pull-forward.
findings.independence: Same company document family: the Q1 補足資料 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260717/140120260717595972.pdf) says 'H1 progressing smoothly'. The peer evidence is mixed and dated earlier: タカミヤ Apr-Jun 経常 was 4.1x (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2445&b=k202608060217), while ダイサン May-Jul swung to a loss (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4750&b=k202609010003). There is no independent series for Alinco's Q2.

findings.finding: The ¥1bn / 1.1m-share buyback (May 7, 2026 to Apr 27, 2027) had used ¥630m and 586,400 shares by Sep 30, buying 74,400 shares in September. About ¥370m remains, so the company keeps buying through the window, roughly 10% of the ¥39m median daily turnover.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The buyback's announcement on 2026-05-01, alongside the FY guide, gave +1.46% next session (kabutan 2026-05-07 article credits the buyback and the guide). No separate reaction is measurable for the monthly status reports.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the program is known. What it adds is a standing bid that softens a negative reaction in a thin name. That is a small asymmetry, not news.
findings.independence: The Q1 補足資料 gives the same program's earlier progress (241,200 shares by 6/30): same issuer, so not independent.

outside_window.finding: The FY plan of OP 3,000m (+35.6%) implies H2 OP of about 1,600m against 956m last year (+67%). Last year the company held a FY plan of 3,100m through the Q2 print and then missed it by 29% without a formal revision, so any cut most likely comes at Q3 or in April, not at this print.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely. Kabutan's history shows no H1 or FY revision at the Q2 print in 2024 or 2025; the FY plan was held through Q2 2025 despite an H1 miss, and there is no consensus to revise against. Returns: interim ¥22 already set; FY ¥45 under a 40% payout and progressive policy; the buyback is mid-program, so a new return item is unlikely. New-year guide: not applicable at H1. Quarter: Q1 progress is 55.9% of the H1 OP plan against 48.7% last year, and Q2 needs a flat-YoY 618m.

rejected_candidates.candidate: The yen strengthened about 2.7% over Alinco's Q2 (USDJPY about 161.4 on Jun 21 to about 157.0 on Sep 20), which would mean an FX valuation loss below OP and an H1 ordinary profit miss against 1,500m.
rejected_candidates.detail: The Q1 短信 shows a 27.8m FX loss in a quarter when the yen WEAKENED (157.9 to about 161), so the sign mapping from the yen's direction to Alinco's FX line is not established.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Founding-family company アルメイト raised its stake from 16.36% to 17.23% (filing 2026-03-03).
rejected_candidates.detail: Old ownership fact with no bearing on this print beyond the standing buyback support already filed as finding 2. Treated as part of that support rather than as a separate item.

baseline_tension: The lean is mildly positive, against a priced lean of -0.32 (the margin overhang of 12.1x) and a -4.45% 20d run-up, about half of which is the dividend going ex. Strongest positive the release could carry: an H1 OP beat with the FY plan held, plus a buyback mid-program, all looked for. Strongest negative: Q2 payback of Q1's pull-forward procurement, or an FX-driven ordinary-profit miss that kabutan headlines.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rules 1 and 2 address negatives resting on public 月次 and negative tilt. My findings are positive and already sized as partly priced (the Q1 progress rate is public), so applying rule 1 by analogy would double-count that caveat.
